title: KeenTouchstone ReliabilityAggregate
description: N rollouts of one task rolled into a reliability distribution. The SAME shape is emitted in offline, online, and replay contexts (the unified loop). Store distributions, never bare point estimates. $id is a placeholder.

task_key.description: task_id (offline) OR Span.harness.task_signature (online). The grouping key for 'the same task'.

task_key_source.description: How task_key was derived. task_signature carries an intra-cluster coherence readout elsewhere.

context.description: The SAME metric definition across all three = the offline<->online loop.

pass_at_k.description: P(at least one of k succeeds)

pass_hat_k.description: pass^k = P(all k succeed). The headline reliability number.

headline_k.description: The k that pass_at_k / pass_hat_k / their CIs refer to. Added in v0.1 implementation: a headline estimate without its k is ambiguous.

pass_hat_k_ci_low.description: CI on the pass^k ESTIMATE itself (Inspect lacks this).

ci_method.description: Below a few hundred items, do NOT use CLT/Wald; use Bayesian/bootstrap. bootstrap_posterior_envelope (added in v0.1): element-wise envelope of a task-cluster bootstrap and a Jeffreys-posterior band on the same resamples — keeps the decay band monotone along k where a bootstrap alone degenerates near k=n.

reliability_decay_curve.description: pass^k for k = 1..N (Inspect lacks this). Each point carries its own CI.

pass_at_k.description: Capability twin at the same k (added in v0.1: the pass@k-vs-pass^k contrast is the shareable artifact).

attribution.description: Optional model-vs-harness adjudication (SPEC section 6). Measured A/B is high-trust; layer hypothesis is low-trust.

etclovg_layer.description: Ranked HINT only — never an authoritative verdict (SOTA step-attribution ~14%).
